description: Two-way control of what you're looking at. The agent can switch the main view (Browser, Pages, Agents...), show or hide the chat panel, and resize it — and you can right-click anywhere in the app to point at something and send it to the chat (a small panel with one-click questions plus a message box, sharing the element you clicked and where on the page it is). On by default; switch off to remove both halves platform-wide.

settings.label: Allow Hiding Chat
settings.hint: ON (default) lets the agent hide the chat panel to give the main view (e.g. the browser) the full width while it narrates. OFF keeps the chat panel always visible — the agent can still switch views and resize, just not hide chat.

settings.label: Allow Resizing Chat
settings.hint: ON (default) lets the agent widen or narrow the chat panel (e.g. to give the browser more room). OFF locks the chat panel at its current width.

settings.label: Max Chat Width (px)
settings.hint: Upper bound on how wide the agent may make the chat panel, in pixels. 0 means no cap. Requests above this are clamped down. The system floor is 280px regardless.
